deadlines.label: OUAC application deadline (Arts & Science St. George and Applied Science & Engineering)
deadlines.notes: International applicants have the same deadlines as listed. Apply through OUAC. Recommended early application date is 7 Nov 2026 (see below).

deadlines.label: Recommended early application date (apply by 7 Nov, documents by 1 Dec 2026)
deadlines.notes: Applicants who apply by 7 Nov and submit available documents by 1 Dec 2026 are eligible for the first admission round.

deadlines.label: Engineering: Engineering Supplemental Application (ESA) and supporting documents due
deadlines.notes: Mandatory for every Engineering program; the application is not considered without it.

deadlines.label: Arts & Science St. George: supporting documents and Computer Science Supplementary Application due
deadlines.notes: Document deadline for Arts & Science St. George is 1 Feb 2027; the Computer Science Supplementary Application is also due 1 Feb 2027.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Required if English is not your first language (the language learned at home as a child), unless exempt: four or more years of full-time study in a recognized Canadian school in Canada, or four or more years of full-time study in an English-language school in a country where the dominant language is English. Exemption is requested after applying through the applicant portal.

english.notes: IELTS Academic (including IELTS Online and UKVI); overall band 6.5 with no band below 6.0, on a single date. IELTS Indicator and One Skill Retake are not accepted.
Old 0-120 scale, for tests completed before 21 Jan 2026: 89 total with 22 in each of Speaking and Writing. Single sitting; MyBest scores not used; TOEFL Essentials not accepted.
New 1-6 scale, for tests completed on or after 21 Jan 2026: 4.5 overall with 4.5 in Writing and 4.0 in Speaking. Single sitting; MyBest scores not used.
PTE Academic (UKVI accepted): overall 65 with no part below 60.
For tests completed on or after 1 July 2024: overall 120 with 120 in Production.
C1 Advanced or C2 Proficiency: overall 180 with at least 170 in each component. B2 First is not accepted.

tier_notes.general: QS World University Rankings 2027: world rank 32, 2nd of the Canadian universities in the table (S = ranks 1-5 on the national scale; a national scale, so not comparable with US tiers).
